top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology is a mature, complete chain from proglucagon processing and the truncated active peptide to receptor biology and agonists confirmed in large independent outcome trials. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov cover the discovery side, which fits a Physiology or Medicine citation naming the physiology and active form, with therapy as the demonstration. P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is the same achievement with a more translational allocation, so it ranks second; no award ranks last because merit and maturity are not in dispute.
